areas.name: monitor
areas.label: Monitor: catch unsafe behavior at runtime

areas.name: audit
areas.label: Audit: find a hidden problem before deployment

areas.name: fix
areas.label: Fix: remove or steer an unsafe behavior

areas.name: understand
areas.label: Understand: explain how the model works, with no outcome to beat

use_cases.name: build_a_safety_monitor
use_cases.title: Build a safety monitor
use_cases.question: Would a monitor on the model's activations flag deception, prompt injection or harmful intent on new texts, better than the words alone?
use_cases.metric: held-out accuracy of the activation probe, on texts from a different source
use_cases.baseline: bag-of-words and embeddings-only probes on the same texts, and shuffled labels
use_cases.example: Would a linear probe on the residual stream flag prompt-injection attempts better than a bag-of-words baseline?

use_cases.name: check_reasoning_faithfulness
use_cases.title: Check reasoning faithfulness
use_cases.question: Does the model's stated reasoning reflect what actually drives its answer?
use_cases.metric: how often the stated reason matches the input the answer causally depends on
use_cases.baseline: counterfactual edits to the prompt, read off the output alone
use_cases.gap: needs a pathway that plants a hint the answer depends on and checks whether the reasoning mentions it, with attribution to tell what the answer used

use_cases.name: find_failure_modes
use_cases.title: Find failure modes
use_cases.question: Where does my model break or behave unsafely, and can its internals point me there faster?
use_cases.metric: distinct failures found under a fixed query budget, and how severe they are
use_cases.baseline: black-box red-teaming and fuzzing under the same budget
use_cases.gap: needs a pathway that searches from the model's internals (push along a direction or feature, or attack the activations, then find real inputs that do the same) and a scorer for distinct failures; find_a_backdoor is its version with a planted answer

use_cases.name: find_a_backdoor
use_cases.title: Find a backdoor
use_cases.question: Does this model have a hidden trigger that switches on bad behavior, and what is it?
use_cases.metric: whether the trigger was identified, and in how many queries
use_cases.baseline: black-box red-teaming under the same query budget
use_cases.gap: needs model organisms with a planted trigger (a LoRA on a small model) and a pathway that searches under a fixed query budget

use_cases.name: audit_hidden_objective
use_cases.title: Audit a hidden objective
use_cases.question: Is this model pursuing a goal it wasn't meant to have?
use_cases.metric: whether the audit names the planted goal or behavior
use_cases.gap: needs model organisms with a planted objective; Scout and Lens would plan the audit freely, scored against the plant

use_cases.name: detect_sandbagging
use_cases.title: Detect sandbagging
use_cases.question: Is the model deliberately underperforming on a capability evaluation?
use_cases.metric: accuracy at telling sandbagging model organisms from honest ones, and false alarms
use_cases.baseline: behavioral evals: elicitation with fine-tuning or few-shot prompting
use_cases.gap: needs model organisms trained to hide a capability, and a pathway that compares what the activations know with what the output says

use_cases.name: audit_a_finetune
use_cases.title: Audit a fine-tune
use_cases.question: Did a fine-tune change more than it was meant to, such as making the model broadly misaligned?
use_cases.metric: recall of a planted change, and false alarms
use_cases.baseline: comparing the two models' outputs on eval sets
use_cases.gap: model_diffing reports where the models differ; it has no fine-tunes with a planted change to score recall and false alarms against, and no output-diff baseline
use_cases.example: What did instruction tuning change between Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, and in which layers?

use_cases.name: steer_unsafe_behavior
use_cases.title: Steer away from unsafe behavior
use_cases.question: Can I turn down a behavior like sycophancy or bias without damaging everything else?
use_cases.metric: size of the targeted change, against collateral damage on unrelated text
use_cases.gap: concept_direction measures the change against random directions and checks control texts; it doesn't yet run a prompting baseline
use_cases.example: Is grammatical gender in occupation words a direction the model uses, and can removing it stop gendered pronoun predictions?

use_cases.name: remove_spurious_correlation
use_cases.title: Remove a spurious correlation
use_cases.question: Does the answer depend on something it shouldn't, like a name or a dialect, and can I remove that without breaking the task?
use_cases.metric: accuracy on a balanced or shifted test set after the fix
use_cases.baseline: fine-tuning or reweighting on rebalanced data
use_cases.gap: spurious_audit measures the dependence and checks the task survives erasure; it doesn't yet score a shifted test set or run a rebalanced baseline
use_cases.example: Does sentiment classification depend on the reviewer's name, and can erasing it keep the task working?

use_cases.name: unlearn_knowledge
use_cases.title: Edit or unlearn knowledge
use_cases.question: Can I remove hazardous knowledge, or correct a fact, and keep the rest of what the model knows?
use_cases.metric: forgetting on the target (a WMDP-style set), against ability kept elsewhere; for edits, efficacy and paraphrases against damage to neighboring facts
use_cases.baseline: gradient-ascent unlearning; fine-tuning on the corrected fact
use_cases.gap: editing_comparison scores ROME edits on single facts; it doesn't yet unlearn a body of knowledge or run a gradient-based baseline
use_cases.example: Is the layer where causal tracing locates a landmark's city the best layer to edit it with ROME?

use_cases.name: resist_image_injection
use_cases.title: Resist prompt injection in images
use_cases.question: Does text written in an image override what the image shows, or what the user asked?
use_cases.metric: accuracy on attacked images, against accuracy on clean ones
use_cases.baseline: prompting, and a light fine-tune on attacked images
use_cases.gap: the lever tools can find and ablate the heads that read the text; there's no pathway or attacked test set yet
use_cases.example: Which CLIP heads read text stamped on an image, and does ablating them stop the label flipping?

use_cases.name: reduce_hallucination
use_cases.title: Reduce object hallucination
use_cases.question: Is my VLM answering from the image, or making things up from what the language model expects?
use_cases.gap: the lever tools measure how much an answer needs the image; there's no pathway yet that intervenes and scores hallucination
use_cases.example: How much of LLaVA's answer to 'Is there a dog in the image?' comes from the image rather than the language prior?

use_cases.name: remove_spurious_background
use_cases.title: Remove a spurious background
use_cases.question: Is my image classifier using the background instead of the object?
use_cases.metric: worst-group accuracy on a balanced test set (Waterbirds)
use_cases.baseline: group reweighting, and retraining the linear head
use_cases.gap: the lever tools nominate and ablate CLIP heads; there's no pathway yet that picks heads and scores worst-group accuracy
use_cases.example: Which CLIP heads carry the background in Waterbirds, and does ablating them raise worst-group accuracy?

use_cases.name: understand_a_capability
use_cases.title: Understand a capability
use_cases.question: How does the model do X?
use_cases.metric: circuit faithfulness: how much of the behavior the circuit recovers
use_cases.baseline: random circuits of the same size
use_cases.example: Which attention heads and MLPs implement indirect object identification?

use_cases.name: locate_a_fact
use_cases.title: Locate a fact
use_cases.question: Where does the model retrieve a fact?
use_cases.metric: indirect effect of restoring each layer and position
use_cases.example: At which layers and token positions does the model recall the city a landmark is in?

use_cases.name: explain_an_output
use_cases.title: Explain an output
use_cases.question: Why did the model say X here? Which features drive it?
use_cases.metric: how much clamping the top SAE features moves the answer
use_cases.baseline: random features at the same layer
use_cases.example: Which SAE features drive the model to complete a famous quote?
